content:
Hi everyone, my name is Nicholas Cimino. Feel free to call me Nick.

I'm sort of just getting going with math and considering a return to university to study math and physics. My background is in behavioural neuroscience and addictions counselling, but I have found a fascination with math since leaving post-secondary. I'm new to Lean, and programming in general, but thought this would be a nice way to learn more about both.

I have been playing around with Lean a bit as a way to engage with the community beyond my own self-study.

Thank you all! :slight_smile:
